role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 当龙骑士化身为可怕的古龙形态，他面前的敌人都会不禁感到害怕。身坚甲厚又能随机应变，眩晕他的敌人并使他们烈焰焚身，他让他的盟友获得凌驾对手的胜势。
hero_summary_en: When he takes on his terrifying dragon form, Dragon Knight strikes fear into any who face him. Strong and adaptable, he can stun his enemies and burn all in front of him, often providing his allies the momentum they need to carry them to victory.

abilities.name: dragon_knight_breathe_fire
abilities.description_zh: 向龙骑士的前方喷射出一团火焰，烧灼碰到的敌人，并使其攻击力降低。
abilities.description_en: Unleashes a breath of fire in front of Dragon Knight that burns enemies and reduces the damage their attacks deal.
notes_zh: 不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。
notes_en: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

abilities.name: dragon_knight_dragon_tail
abilities.description_zh: 龙骑士用盾对身边的一个敌方单位进行打击，对它和它身边的目标造成眩晕和伤害。
abilities.description_en: Dragon Knight smites an enemy unit with his shield, stunning and damaging it and units close to it.

abilities.name: dragon_knight_wyrms_wrath
abilities.description_zh: 神龙的生命之血提升了龙骑士的技能和物品，使其拥有作用范围加成，并且攻击会对敌方单位造成额外魔法伤害。
abilities.description_en: The life blood of the Dragon improves Dragon Knight's abilities and items to have increased AoE and causes his attacks to deal additional magic damage to enemy units.

abilities.name: dragon_knight_fireball
abilities.description_zh: 点燃一片区域，对其中的敌人持续造成伤害，伤害效果还会粘滞。近战形态下施放距离较近。
abilities.description_en: Ignites an area, dealing damage over time that lingers on enemies in it. Has reduced cast range when melee.

abilities.name: dragon_knight_dragon_blood
abilities.description_zh: 神龙的生命之血提升了龙骑士的生命恢复和护甲。在古龙形态下生命恢复和护甲均提升%regen_and_armor_multiplier_during_dragon_form%%%。
abilities.description_en: The life blood of the Dragon improves Dragon Knight's health regeneration and armor.  Regen and armor are increased by %regen_and_armor_multiplier_during_dragon_form%%% during Elder Dragon Form.
facet_text_en: Attacks deal additional magic damage to enemy units. Spells and items have increased AoE.
Attacks are filled with lethal poison that affects enemy units and structures, reducing armor and dealing physical damage over time.
Attacks are filled with frost that affects enemy units, slowing movement speed, attack speed, and reducing health restoration.
facet_text_zh: 攻击会对敌方单位造成额外魔法伤害，并且技能和物品的作用范围提升。
攻击附带致命的毒素，可作用于敌方单位和建筑，降低护甲并持续造成物理伤害。
攻击带有冰霜，会作用于敌方单位，降低移动速度和攻击速度，同时降低生命回复。

abilities.name: dragon_knight_elder_dragon_form
abilities.description_zh: 龙骑士化身为古龙，提升了技能的施法距离，获得移动速度加成，和拥有各种特性的远程攻击。古龙每级都会进化。加成效果会累加。1级碧龙：攻击获得持续的腐蚀伤害，也能作用于建筑。2级赤龙：攻击获得溅射伤害。3级苍龙：攻击获得无视减益免疫的移动速度和攻击速度降低效果。
abilities.description_en: Dragon Knight assumes the form of the Elder Dragon, increasing the range of his abilities, gaining bonus movement speed, and a ranged attack with various properties.  The Dragon evolves per level. The bonuses are cumulative. Level 1 Green: Grants a corrosive damage over time that can also damage buildings.Level 2 Red: Grants splash damage to the dragon's attacks.Level 3 Blue: Grants a debuff immunity piercing movement and attack frost slow on attack.

scepter_loc.en: Increases the current level of Dragon Form by one. Adds a Level 4 Black Dragon that has free pathing, bonus magic resistance, and increased other bonuses.
scepter_loc.zh: 使古龙形态的当前等级提升1级。增加的4级黑龙拥有自由移动，魔法抗性加成和其他更高的加成效果。
